name: cifs_upload
author: jm33-ng
comment: Upload a file to a remote SMB/CIFS share (UNC) under the module's token/ticket identity. Use it for hosts that do not run an agent: stage the payload on this agent first (CC 'put --src <local> --dst mem:///...' into memfs, or host it and pass an http(s):// URL), then push it straight onto \\target\ADMIN$\... / C$\... with the DA identity. Run with --token <SID|session> (stolen DA token or make_token session), or --user <DOMAIN/user> --ticket <base64 kirbi> for the PTT flow. Every CreateFileW/WriteFile impersonates the assigned token, so the SMB redirector authenticates with the stolen identity or the session's imported Kerberos ticket. Pair with 'scshell' to execute the uploaded file on the target.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Payload source on this agent: mem:///path (memfs), a local path like C:\x\payload.exe, or http(s)://URL

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: Destination UNC path below an existing share, e.g. \\DC01\ADMIN$\Temp\stage.exe (intermediate folders are auto-created). Use the hostname rather than an IP for --ticket/PTT flows so Kerberos is used

parameters.name: delete_src
parameters.description: Remove the local/memfs source file after a successful upload

parameters.name: verify
parameters.description: Re-open the destination and confirm its size after upload

name: cifs_rm
author: jm33-ng
comment: Remove a file (or an empty directory) from a remote SMB/CIFS share under the module's token/ticket identity — the cleanup half of cifs_upload. dest is a UNC path like \\DC01\ADMIN$\Temp\stage.exe; pass --rmdir true to remove a directory instead. Same token model as cifs_upload: --token <SID|session>, or --user/--ticket for PTT. DeleteFileW/RemoveDirectoryW run impersonated, so the SMB redirector authenticates with the stolen identity or the imported Kerberos ticket.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: UNC path of the file (or, with rmdir=true, the empty directory) to remove, e.g. \\DC01\ADMIN$\Temp\stage.exe

parameters.name: rmdir
parameters.description: Remove an empty directory instead of a file
